answer.summary: Every failing test is a Spring ApplicationContext load failure, not a flake. The change's new query PayloadIdentityRepository.findAllActionIdsByTenantIdWithOlderVersionsInUse is not valid SQL for JSqlParser (ParseException at line 15, column 68, near "ANDi"), so the bean fails and the context cannot start. The same error repeats on every retry, so re-running will fail again.
